_comment: Facts copied from your own report files or derived by arithmetic from their confusion matrices. Nothing here was re-run or re-measured by the platform. Edit/extend this file if you re-evaluate a model.

reference_policies_derived.basis: computed from the class counts above and the official cost matrix

cost_sensitive_model.joblib.identification: Report title 'COST-SENSITIVE MODEL - OFFICIAL VALIDATION'; app.py loads this file. Mapping inferred, not proven.
cost_sensitive_model.joblib.evaluation: official validation set, latest readout per vehicle
reliability_notes: Documented official-validation behaviour of this artifact: it predicted class 4 for 4,991 of 5,046 vehicles (98.9%), including 4,855 of 4,910 class-0 vehicles (source: cost_sensitive_report.txt).

Its reported mean cost (9.7495) is close to the always-class-4 reference (9.8228, derived) and well above the 5.1-5.6 internal random-cutoff simulations, which are a different protocol and not official scores.

balanced_baseline_model.joblib.identification: Written by evaluate_official_validation.py, which loads balanced_baseline_model.joblib.
balanced_baseline_model.joblib.evaluation: official validation set, latest readout per vehicle, argmax predictions
reliability_notes: Documented official-validation behaviour of this artifact: it predicted class 4 for 4,576 of 5,046 vehicles (90.7%); class-0 recall 9.2% (source: official_validation_report.txt).
Cost derived from its reported confusion matrix: 45,684 total, 9.0535 per vehicle.

baseline_model.joblib.identification: Initial internal baseline report; model file mapping inferred.
reliability_notes: Internal baseline predicted class 0 for every row (balanced accuracy 0.20); it has no failure detection ability (source: baseline_evaluation.txt).

internal_simulations_user_reported.note: Reported by the project owner for the calibrated expected-cost rule on internal vehicle-held-out random-cutoff runs. The results.json files were not available when this platform was built, so these figures are unverified here. They are NOT official challenge scores.
